states.title: States
states.description: States to search. Leave empty for all supported states.

formedWithinDays.title: Formed within the last (days)
formedWithinDays.description: Only businesses registered in the last N days. Ignored when "Formed on or after" is set. States publish with different delays (see README), so 30 days covers all of them.

formedAfter.title: Formed on or after
formedAfter.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides "Formed within the last (days)".

entityTypes.title: Entity types
entityTypes.description: Normalized entity categories to include. Leave empty for all.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Exact city names, matched case-insensitively against the business address, e.g. Denver, Portland.

zipCodes.title: ZIP codes
zipCodes.description: 5-digit ZIP codes or 3-4 digit prefixes, e.g. 80202 or 802.

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: County names, e.g. Kings, Allegheny. Only NY and PA publish counties; other states are skipped when this is set.

nameKeywords.title: Keywords in business name
nameKeywords.description: Only businesses whose name contains any of these words, e.g. roofing, dental, construction.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of businesses to return across all states. Each result is billed as one event.

onlyNew.title: Only new businesses (delta mode)
onlyNew.description: Skip businesses already returned by earlier runs with the same search settings. Ideal for scheduled daily or weekly runs.
